tasks.label: Arduino: Build active sketch (Uno)
args:
set -euo pipefail
sketch_file="$1"
sketch_name="$2"
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/$sketch_name"
cp "$sketch_file" "$tmpdir/$sketch_name/$sketch_name.ino"
"$HOME/.local/bin/arduino-cli" compile --fqbn arduino:avr:uno --build-path "$tmpdir/build" "$tmpdir/$sketch_name"
tasks.detail: Compiles only the active .ino for Arduino Uno using Arduino CLI.
